meta.title: Subagent cap
meta.description: Limits how many subagents may run concurrently in a single session (default 1). A real in-flight-aware slot allocator stops two parallel spawns from racing past the cap, and over the cap the new delegate is either rejected or held in a true FIFO queue until a slot frees. Settings are ordinary volatile plugin Config, persisted by DSH into the profile patch.
